programme.title: Alan Cummings: Paradise Homes
programme.desc: On a journey back to his rugged roots of the Scottish Highlands, Alan experiences an extraordinary hidden getaway living in harmony with ancient land, complete with 360 views and golden eagles circling the property. In Sicily, Alan tours an eccentric family home built above a cave, filled with innovative and intricate space-saving details, including a one-of-a-kind bedroom climbing wall!

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: Marilia's transformative Bali journey unfolded with cultural immersion and healing escapades. Tirta Empul temple brought purification and Wira's guidance. She relished nature's power at Tibumana waterfall and swung on Balinese swings. Mr. Ketut's healing, coconut blessings, and palm readings soothed her soul. The Yoga Barn's water healing session, blending watsu and dance, transported her to new realms. Serenity embraced her through local cuisine, scenic vistas, and Brian's violin melodies. Engaging with Balinese traditions, she crafted temple offerings and explored coconut oil production. Bingin Beach's natural beauty inspired reflection, while Uluwatu Surfing Villas hosted her show. A Vespa ride captured precious moments in Uluwatu's enchanting surroundings. Marilia's Bali odyssey: a harmonious blend of culture, healing, and adventure.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: Marilia had a memorable trip to Malaysia. She visited Christine's Dog Sanctuary, played with dogs, and discussed animal preservation. Emotional interviews were conducted with Angela and Christine. Marilia enjoyed a traditional Malaysian vegetarian lunch and explored dog waste management. Acro yoga with Sasa and friends brought laughter. Dr. Lee provided acupuncture sessions and explained meridian points. They met at the Ruma Hotel with stunning views of Kuala Lumpur. Marilia gathered flowers and spices at Urban Nomads Garden with Janice, who prepared a delightful coconut soup and salad. Marilia met Justin Chea, director of Kechara Soup Kitchen, and volunteered for food preparation and distribution. Filming and reflection took place at Independence Square. The trip ended with relaxation by the pool and a refreshing swim, appreciating the hotel's architecture and views. Marilia's journey in Malaysia was diverse, including animal care, wellness, culinary exploration, volunteerism, and self-reflection, making it truly memorable.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: Marilia’s journey on South Africa's Garden Route explores plant medicine, beauty in nature, and animal communication, emphasizing the profound connection between humans and the natural world.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, Marilia explores various locations in Cornwall. She visits Boscastle, known for its witch stories, and enjoys ocean views from a field. She also explores Merlin's Cave and meets a life coach named Euan in St Neot. Marilia engages in nature bathing and encounters wildlife while walking towards Muir. At Joe's home and studio, she assists him in painting and enjoys his vinyl covers and guitar music. Marilia learns about animal massage therapy from Jenna and goes on a carriage ride through rural scenery. She joins the Seaweeders for seaweed foraging, visits the drying warehouse, and meets Gemma, an Alexander Technique specialist. Marilia also takes time to relax at a hotel spa, filming her show against the stunning ocean cliff. This episode offers a captivating exploration of Cornwall's landscapes, encounters with talented individuals, and immersive experiences.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: Marilia embarks on a captivating journey, capturing the essence of Treasure Island through extraordinary encounters. They film hidden treasures and enchanting allure against stunning backdrops. At Fort DeSoto, Marilia embraces the tranquil beauty of the beach, while Ashley leads them to Boyd Hill National Park for profound conversations beneath a magnificent tree. In Ashley's studio, a tea ceremony symbolizes tranquility and connection, followed by an intimate interview unveiling her artistry. Gulfport Beach becomes a sanctuary for transformative sound healing, and Marilia rides a bike along the boardwalk, capturing the synergy between nature and human activity. Marilia meets Justin, capturing his unique vision and creativity, and encounters Lindy, a captivating sound healer. Dolphin Yoga at CMA merges Marilia's practice with the playful marine world, while Levi guides her through an extraordinary dolphin feeding session. Clearwater Marine Aquarium showcases the dedication of the staff and educates visitors about marine conservation. In Irene's studio, Marilia explores the wellness aspect of Flamenco dance. The journey concludes at Mirror Lake, encapsulating the profound impact of Marilia's experiences through heartfelt testimonials and reflective voice-overs.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: In Joshua Tree, our journey began with Gabi, our knowledgeable astrology expert, who gracefully guided us through the mesmerizing wonders of the full moon, mercury retrogrades, and the celestial constellations. We then found ourselves immersed in the transformative realm of sound healing, led by the enchanting melodies of Alchemy. Marilia experienced profound rejuvenation as her body, mind, and soul were harmonized by the ethereal vibrations of diverse instruments.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: In the LA episode, our journey began with an awe-inspiring hike alongside the wolves. Wolf Connection revealed the magical nature of these animals and sparked a conversation about the connection between women and wolves. We then delved into Ayurveda, learning from Jay about the presence of nature in our bodies and how to maintain balance. Karla, an Ayurvedic chef, treated us to a delightful meal while emphasizing the importance of food for our well-being. Marilia fearlessly took a leap from an airplane, showing us how extreme sports can free us from fear. Lastly, Tracy showcased her life and passion for WCMX at the skate park, highlighting the joy found in pursuing our passions.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Richard and comedian Katherine Ryan take a fast and funny trip to New York. Their overflowing schedule includes skyscrapers, roller blades, museums, ferries, show-tunes and cronuts.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Hollywood actor Paul Rudd joins Richard to discover Finland's seaside capital, with a time-efficient exploration by kayak, a good steaming in the city's saunas and salty sweets.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Actor and comedian Adam Buxton joins Richard for a high-speed tour of Portugal's capital, with trams, rickshaw, funicular and fado, and a visit to a doll hospital.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Watch Richard and Jack Dee take a trip to Naples featuring humor, history, culture, pizza, Vespas and chaotic traffic, a trip to Capri, and a guide to the meaning of dreams.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Comedian Rob Beckett joins Richard Ayoade in Russia's cultural capital, for a post-Soviet itinerary including an armoured tank, caviar, vodka, and a herring in a fur coat.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Richard and comedian Aisling Bea make a whirlwind tour of Hungary's fairy-tale capital, with selfies, goulash, cake, pubs, liquor, and a game of chess at the thermal baths.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade packs his case and heads to the Canaries to discover what lies beyond the all-inclusive resorts of the volcanic island of Tenerife. Making the trip from LA to join him is writer, director and actor, Lena Dunham.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Richard and Rhod Gilbert's high-speed visit to Florida's famous hot spot takes in art, art deco, alligators, speedboats, an airboat tour of the everglades - and dominoes.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Hollywood actor Rebel Wilson joins Richard for a fun-packed whizz round Florence in a mini-break mixing art, action, gelato, a drive in a classic Alfa Romeo, and some tripe.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Richard is joined by Matt Lucas, actor, comedian and many other things besides, for a frenetic 48 hours in the eternal city, Rome. Over a packed duo of days they cram in culture, cuisine, history, hats and as many sights as they can see.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade is joined by comedian Sara Pascoe for a two day test of the mini break merits of Valencia. Together they ruthlessly examine Spain's third largest city, taking in its history, parks, architecture, culture and cuisine, as well as falling under the powerful spell of local cocktail agua de Valencia.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade and comedian Joe Lycett head to the mini break mecca of Amsterdam for a 48 hour hurtle through the city's attractions. In just two days the pair power through culture, cardio, canals, cuisine and much more, not all of it beginning with a 'c'.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade and actress Sally Phillips head to Stockholm for a fulsome 48 hours in the Swedish capital. Together they scale rooftops, sing Abba, eat Swedish-Danish, and stay up late playing on their phones.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.desc: If you were tasked to race across the world with limited cash and nothing in the way of modern technology, how do you think you’d fare? BBC2’s Race Across the World returns, as five teams attempt just that. This series takes viewers on the trip of a lifetime, following our contestants as they embark on an epic and adrenaline-fuelled adventure, travelling into the unknown without the trappings of modern life.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.desc: Five teams have been set the challenge to travel from the top to the bottom of Latin America - leaving behind smartphones, internet access and credit cards and armed with only the cash equivalent of a one-way airfare from Mexico City to Ushuaia.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.desc: Five teams have been set the challenge to travel from the top to the bottom of Latin America - leaving behind smartphones, internet access and credit cards and armed with only the cash equivalent of a one-way airfare from Mexico City to Ushuaia.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.desc: As the 25,000 km race to Ushuaia approaches the half-way mark, the four teams compete not just with each other, but with the extreme altitudes of Peru.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.desc: As the 25,000 km race to Ushuaia approaches the half-way mark, the four teams compete not just with each other, but with the extreme altitudes of Peru.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.desc: With three teams at the checkpoint – Cafayate in Argentina - one team is yet to arrive. Dom and Lizzie are over 24 hours behind their competitors and after a disastrous last leg, they must rely on all their ingenuity to claw their way back into the race.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.desc: With two teams at the checkpoint –Ilha Grande in Brazil – the two remaining teams are engaged in a frantic race to avoid finishing the leg in last place. Dom and Lizzie are on foot, running through the jungle whilst Jo and Sam are paddling furiously in a canoe across the bay. It’s a nail-biting ending and the siblings just manage to edge out their rivals and sign into the book.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.desc: After twenty-one thousand kilometres, two continents and seventeen countries. The teams embark on the final leg of their epic journey. However, a mammoth 4800km still stands between them and the finish line of Ushuaia, Argentina, the most southerly city in the world.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.desc: Over 54 days, five pairs of ordinary Brits took on the challenge of a lifetime and attempted to travel, at ground level, the entire length of Latin America: from Mexico City to Ushuaia, Argentina, the most southerly city in the world – with no planes, no credit cards and no smartphones in sight. They came across extreme weather, states of emergency, evacuations, challenging budgets as well as life-changing encounters, incredible acts of generosity and dramatic landscapes. Most of all, they had to survive each other.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.desc: In the Season Premier - An exhilarating journey through Guatemala’s Petén Department reveals the ancient Maya site of Holmul and a historic convent transformed into a museum, offering a glimpse into the region’s layered history and culture.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger tries on the “Shoe Panties” and admires the “Flip ‘N Flush” and other wacky inventions at the INPEX trade show in Pittsburgh; avoids becoming tiger food at the Big Cat Sanctuary in Tampa; and then ventures to Vermont to see art created and captured from Spider Webs.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: The French are famous for their haute cuisine with its extravagant presentations and complex techniques. After swimming with wild dolphins Brent meets with Michael Scioli, head chef at the prestigious hotel, Le Constance Prince Maurice on the east coast of the Island. Chef Michael shows him how to prepare a specialized French seafood dish using ingredients straight from the hotel's garden. Seeing as you can never have too much adventure, Brent then tries out fly and dive boarding (mainly dive) which is essentially a water powered jet pack. After an afternoon of fun, he limps into the hotel veggie garden to pick some ingredients for his own feast of French fusion prawns and coconut heart salad as the sun sets on anther beautiful day in paradise.

programme.desc: Visit a food shelter for the disadvantaged & Meet musician Machito Ruiz who teaches salsa dancing.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We discover Franklin, TN also known to its locals for being voted as best small town in TN. From there we explore the history of downtown Franklin and end the day with some amazing southern cuisine.

programme.desc: Phillip joins old friend, Ryan Clift, chef-owner of the newly located Tippling Club, number 23 on the San Pellegrino Asia’s 50 Best Restaurants List and known for it’s modern gastronomy and specialty cocktails.

programme.title: A Taste of Italy with Nisha Katona
programme.desc: Chef and restaurateur Nisha Katona goes on a culinary journey to discover Italy's hidden foodie gems, learning the regional secrets that influence their dishes

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the Season Premier - An exhilarating journey through Guatemala’s Petén Department reveals the ancient Maya site of Holmul and a historic convent transformed into a museum, offering a glimpse into the region’s layered history and culture.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger finds an abundance of dairy products and lactose-tolerance at Cheese Days in Monroe, Wisconsin; observes snake milking at the world's largest Rattlesnake Roundup in Texas; and learns the challenges of living in a 727 jet in Oregon.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, host Will Clinger pays homage to the iconic signs of yesteryear at the Neon Boneyard, and then witnesses a miracle cure at Hangover Heaven; and in Houston, he joins the revved up crowd at America's largest Art Car Parade.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger stares in amazement at the largest airplane ever built - Howard Hughes' "Spruce Goose" on display in McMinnville, Oregon; admires the aluminum siding at Houston's Beer Can House and then pulls over for gas station memorabilia at Classical Gas near Taos, New Mexico

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger gets an explosive tour at Las Vegas' National Atomic Testing Museum, and plays classic machines at the Pinball Hall of Fame; watches a parade that doesn't move an inch in Whalan, Minnesota; and then goes souvenir hunting at the Los Angeles Coroner's Gift Shop.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger offers his condolences at Houston's Museum of Funeral Customs; celebrates the weird and wonderful world of sculptor Dr. Evermor in Wisconsin; and drops in on a Portland donut shop to play witness at a VooDoo Wedding.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger looks on with envy at the World Beard & Mustache Championship held in Portland, Oregon; unearths the Lost Egyptian city from the 1923 epic "Ten Commandments" beneath the sand dunes on the California coast; and explores a lively Los Angeles museum devoted solely to Death.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger finds himself in the middle of an ice cream-related catastrophe at the Ben & Jerry’s Factory in Waterbury, Vermont; mingles with the mermaids at the underwater show in Weeki Wachee, Florida; and then marvels at the Bug Art portraits made from thousands of insects in Vermont.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger tries to ride an alligator at Orlando’s Gatorland; drops in on a New Hampshire used car dealership with a priceless collection of Muhammad Ali memorabilia; and then dabbles in the paranormal at the abandoned and haunted West Virginia State Penitentiary.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger learns the hazards of professional Golf Ball Diving in Kissimmee; considers defecting to a foreign country at a library that straddles the U.S. – Canadian border; and then catches his breath in Donora, Pennsylvania at the world’s only Smog Museum.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger gets righteously hammered at a Pittsburgh church converted into a microbrewery; solves forensic puzzles while observing the Nutshell Dioramas of Unexplained Death in Baltimore; and then covers his ears as the engines roar at Orlando Speedway’s Test ‘n Tune Night.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger prays that his car won’t stall Daytona Beach’s Drive-in Church; smokes a stogie that’s just been rolled at Tampa’s Tabanero Cigar Factory; tours the Cypress Cove Nudist Colony* in Orlando; and celebrates an historic barnyard accident at Colorado’s Mike the Headless Chicken Festival.*no actual nudity on camera

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger tries on the “Shoe Panties” and admires the “Flip ‘N Flush” and other wacky inventions at the INPEX trade show in Pittsburgh; avoids becoming tiger food at the Big Cat Sanctuary in Tampa; and then ventures to Vermont to see art created and captured from Spider Webs.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We explore Hoboken and learn all about the charm of this famous neighborhood. Starting out the day with the "Mozzeralla Boss" we learn how to make mozzeralla from the king himself. From there we learn more about the history of Hoboken and its famous residents including the late Frank Sinatra. We end our day with art and fresh made delicacys.

programme.desc: Host Will Clinger meets Mr. Pierogi and celebrates Pierogi Fest in Whiting, Indiana; ducks for cover at Lambert’s Café “Home of the Throwed Rolls” in Alabama; and cheers on the daring (and possibly deranged) participants at a Unicycle Football game in San Marcos, Texas.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Sugar is commonly known on the island as the Mauritian Miracle, having once been the backbone of Mauritius's economy. Brent visits L'Adventure du Sucre museum and gets a fascinating look at how the Mauritian history is tightly intertwined with sugar. He then heads in to the fields to for some fun cutting cane before meeting up with Chef Oliver and who shows Brent just how much Mauritians love sugar and spice. Brent then heads out to the stunning and exclusive island, Ile Des Deux Cocos, for some snorkeling in a marine sanctuary and then cooks up his own Mauritian tropical desert on a remote coral beach.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Darwin is the capital of Australia’s Northern Territory and a former frontier outpost. It’s also a gateway to the massive Kakadu National Park. Darwin attracts travellers from all around the globe looking to experience its outdoor tropical lifestyle. If balmy nights, colourful characters and outdoor adventures are on your bucket list, you’ll want to visit Darwin – just like our All Stars!

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Margaret River is a small town south of Perth in western Australia, known for its wineries, beaches migratory whales and coastal adventures. Stretching between 2 lighthouses north and south of the town, the region fringes the limestone caves and sea cliffs of Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park. For over 50,000 years the Margaret River Region has supported one of the world’s longest, unbroken human occupations, resulting in an immensely deep connection to the land. Natural beauty, abundance of space, fine wine and fresh coastal air make this episode a must-watch.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Rivers region of New South Wales, Australia, The Tweed is adjacent to the border with Queensland. Here, nature is more thana backdrop, it’s a source of inspiration: from tropical landscapes, ancient rainforests, and world-class adventures. The Tweed is a place where sparkling seaside villages, riverside towns and hinterland hamlets create endless holiday experiences. Once you discover this place, it’s hard to forget.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Marlborough is a region of New Zealand, at the northeastern tip of the South Island. It’s well known for Marlborough Sounds, an extensive network of coastal waterways, peninsulas and islands. This area also boasts some of the world’s best walking tracks, taking in coastal forest, coves, inlets, and spectacular skyline ridges. Marlborough’s diverse landscapes – from valleys of vines to sheltered waterways – offers the perfect destination for a week of unrivalled fun and adventure.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Brisbane, capital of Queensland, is a large city on the Brisbane River. This stunning sunshine capital has no shortage of bucket list items, and our All Stars certainly ticked off a few. During this trip we also got to experience Brisbane backyard, with Moreton Bay’s tropical islands on the city’s doorstep, including beautiful North Stradbroke. Add to this a dynamic cultural precinct, abundant wildlife and easy access adventure destinations like the Gold Coast and Great Barrier Reef, and you’ve got a destination you can’t say no to.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: The Sapphire Coast is located approximately halfway between Melbourne and Sydney and just three hours from Canberra, located on the far south coast of New South Wales. The roll call of magnificence is almost endless in this gem-like stretch of coast, the most southerly in the state. Discover some of the world’s best whale watching, oysters plucked straight from pristine waters, beaches where yours will be the only footprints, immense tracts of national parks and serene ocean pools. Has a coastline ever been better named?

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We live like a local in The Hamptons. From paddle boarding the morning away to learning about art and history from the local experts we see everything the Hamptons has to offer. We top off the day with a classic float from the locals favorite spot.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Phillip takes us to Spanish restaurant Catalunya, one of Wine & Dine Singapore’s top restaurants in 2013, helmed by Executive Chef Alain Devahive Toloso, previously of Michelin starred elBulli, to see just what makes this restaurant so special.

programme.desc: Danny and Elliot avoid military service by pretending to be gay, but they have to act the part when the recruiting officer doesn't buy it.

programme.title: All the Way Boys
programme.desc: A pair of conniving bush pilots crash-land in the Peruvian jungle, where they come across a community of diamond miners under the thumb of a greedy speculator.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Briggite monta en cólera en el consultorio del ginecólogo. No puede creer que esté menopáusica. Pero el doctor la quita del error. Es una etapa que finaliza pero otra comienza. El Doctor Caridad insulta a junior y le dice que si él no le dice a Jesica hoy que su esposa está embarazada | se lo dice él y que no quiere hablar más del matrimonio. Junior está feliz y pensando en regresar hoy mismo para su casa. ROKUro y Dionisia se despiden hasta una próxima vez.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: La noticia del embarazo de Cristina causa revuelo y tanto Gladis como Rómulo están muy molestos con sus respectivos hijos. Después, muy molesto va Rómulo a casa de Gladis para enfrentar a Gerson y exigirle que se responsabilice de su nueva paternidad.

programme.title: Episodio 5
programme.desc: Las mentiras de Katiuska envuelven a Celia, convenciéndola de un falso matrimonio con Ricardo, aunque Elizabeth ve a través de su hipocresía. En la mansión, el deseo de Manuela por ser madre pone en jaque a Ricardo. Durante una salida, un encuentro fortuito revela a Manuela la existencia del pasado oculto de su esposo, sembrando en ella la semilla de la duda. Mientras Marcelo enfrenta una crisis matrimonial severa, Manuela jura descubrir si esa misteriosa mujer aún es dueña de Ricardo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Maricela visita a Alejandro reclamando explicaciones por terminar con Rosalía. Arminda manipula a Carmen ofreciéndole dinero para alejarla de Blanca, pero ella se niega. Eustoquio lleva a Isaías ante Erasto, quien intriga contra Adolfo y le ofrece dinero para comprar el local de Consuelo. Erasto encuentra a Blanca y exige el divorcio; ella se niega, planeando heredar su fortuna. Adolfo intenta ayudar económicamente a Consuelo pero recibe su desprecio. Rosalía manipula a Adolfo para obligar a Alejandro a regresar con ella.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene llega a la casa de Leonardo para asistir a Rebeca por la fiebre que está sufriendo. Agustina se pone en su camino y le prohíbe la entrada, argumentando que Leonardo dijo explícitamente que no la dejara pasar nadie a Irene. Ella termina subiendo con el permiso de la señora Jimena. A Rebeca se le cura la fiebre por la alegría que le causa la presencia de Irene. Leonardo e Irene tienen un encontronazo en el que él intenta convencerla de que vuelva a su casa. Leo va a buscar a María Lucía para informarle que Oriana finalmente no está embarazada y para confesarle su amor. Julio, su hermano, se enfada con Leo e intenta impedir que hable a solas con María Lucía.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Aída quiere decirle algo muy importante a Sol y Reina se interpone. En ese momento llega Heriberto con la noticia de que Sol está libre por decisión del juez. Y le dice a Reina que él y Sol se van a vivir juntos. Maricielo encuentra a su padre infraganti en un bar con su amante. Ella pone el grito en el cielo y decide volver a vivir a lo de su madre junto a Torombolo, Bárbara y Eloycito. Ramón se opone rotundamente al casamiento entre Alicia y Carlucho.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Virginia le confirma a su madre, Trinidad, de que va a trabajar en Ferrándiz. Trinidad no lo acepta de ninguna manera. Rebeca se cura gracias a la asistencia de Irene, que, a su vez se reconcilia con Leonardo. La señora Jimena se entera por su hijo que Virginia va a trabajar en la empresa, reniega de eso y va a solicitar un impedimento legal para que ella no se pueda acercar a su familia. Julio se pelea con su hermano Leonardo por causa del embarazo supuestamente falso de Oriana y le cuenta a su padre que Leonardo se reconcilió con María Lucía. Virginia se encuentra en la oficina con Rodrigo, alguien del pasado, que trata de abusar de ella. María Lucía, que se había reconciliado con Leonardo, queda desilusionada por la pelea que él tuvo con Ricardo.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: El doctor le entrega a Alejandro los resultados del examen de ADN que se hizo para determinar si era padre tanto del hijo de Aída como del de Sol. Ya que las pruebas que él leyó determinaban que el hijo de Sol no es suyo, él la visita para decirle que no quiere verla nunca más. Sol aprovecha este alejamiento de Alejandro para evitar tener problemas al confrontar a su madre. Pero le duele mucho eso ya que sabe que no es verdad, que él es el padre de su hijo y que Reina cambió las pruebas de ADN.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri y Wilker siguen debajo de la lluvia. Ella le dice que vayan al gimnasio para secarse el acepta. Finita | Ana y Briggite están almorzando en un restaurante. Finita y Ana le dicen que Yubiri le está serruchando el puesto y además quitándole el novio a la hija. Briggite les informa que tiene la menopausia. En la casa de Fabián están Pastor | Olegario y Junior hablando de la menopausia de Briggite. Todos están de acuerdo que obligatoriamente tiene que casarse con Jesica.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Doroteo entra al baño de María Antonia mientras ella se baña, pero para sorpresa de ambos, llega Aristiguieta y ellos intentan evadirlo. Por otro lado, la abogada sorprende en la mentira a Theo y le urge que llegue para aclarar las cosas.

programme.title: Episodio 6
programme.desc: El drama se intensifica cuando Manuela jura destruir su matrimonio si descubre que Ricardo la engaña. Celia, aconsejada por Jade, ejecuta un papel perfecto que logra doblegar a Ricardo, haciéndole retomar sus visitas furtivas. Katiuska acecha desde las sombras, jurando destruir la felicidad de los recién casados. Paralelamente, el infierno de Gustavo con las drogas se agrava, amenazando a la familia Bustamante. Manuela y Ricardo caminan por la cuerda floja del engaño y la traición.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa decide presentarse dignamente en casa de Alejandro y pide un vestido a Mildred, pero Natalia y Mariela la acusan de ladrona humillándola. Isaías, orgulloso de su falsa hazaña, informa a Consuelo que compró el local; ella explota al saber que el dinero vino de Erasto. Arminda y Eustoquio planifican la muerte de Blanca para asegurar la herencia. Adolfo reprocha a Alejandro haber roto con Rosalía. Rosa, sin nada que ponerse, declina la invitación; Alejandro se esconde de Rosalía al verla llegar a la residencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado y Diana llegan a Grecia en busca de nuevos aliados para fortalecer el Cartel de los Casillas. Pero la mafia de Los Balcanes tiene otras intenciones. Pío y Jaime buscan la presidencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado procura un encuentro con Renzo Volpi para hacer negocios, sin imaginar que el líder de los Balcanes le hará una petición que lo pondrá contra la pared. Corina tiene a Ojeda en la mira.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas le dan el último adiós con todos los honores a Aurelio, convertido en una leyenda. Con su muerte se fortalecen y nace el cartel con más poder. Amado y Diana terminan su relación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado planea usar el botín que encontró con Athina para liberarla a ella y a su familia de la deuda que tiene con Volpi. El mafioso le da un ultimátum. Los Casillas preparan su regreso.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado y Volpi no llegan a un acuerdo por lo que se inicia una nueva guerra. Los ataques no se hacen esperar y un integrante de la familia Casillas está en la mira del enemigo.

programme.desc: Dos hermanos separados intentan reconectarse en Navidad, pero hay algo que uno de ellos no puede superar: el otro cree que es un viajero en el tiempo.

programme.title: Volviendo De La Luna De Miel
programme.desc: Cuando Zane y Jeannette regresan de su luna de miel se encuentran con un invitado inesperado esperándolos.

programme.title: Rosemont
programme.desc: Lisa y Brad se conocen durante el trayecto para cruzar las montañas, cinco días antes de Navidad. En el trayecto, sufren un accidente por lo que se refugian en el hotel Rosemont donde comenzará una bella aventura junto con dos personas en Rosemont.

programme.title: Desacuerdo Romántico
programme.desc: Leanna, una artista que diseña portadas de libros, se hace pasar por la esquiva autora de una exitosa novela romántica que en realidad fue escrita en secreto por Michael, un pretencioso novelista literario. Lo que no espera es encontrar el amor ella misma.

programme.title: Navidad Vuelve A Casa
programme.desc: Al borde de una promoción, una exitosa corredora de bienes raíces se ve obligada a regresar a su ciudad natal para reparar una casa victoriana heredada de su abuela.

programme.title: Amor Y Chocolate
programme.desc: Colette tiene una cafetería que alberga su famosa y secreta receta de chocolate caliente. Ella se encuentra compitiendo con Marcus, el amable y nuevo dueño de una tienda de postres que atrae a sus clientes con su propia especialidad de chocolate caliente. Colette cree que le robó la receta, pero le da una oportunidad cuando su tienda tiene que cerrar después de un incendio. Colette trabaja junto con él para reparar su taller, pero puede que no sea suficiente para que se recupere a tiempo para Navidad. Sin embargo, ayudará a Colette a ver a Marcus bajo una luz diferente, especialmente cuando aprenda la fuente de su receta de chocolate caliente. El amor, el chocolate caliente y una conexión inesperada unirán a Marcus y Colette para las fiestas.

programme.title: Un Viaje A París
programme.desc: ¿Los negocios pondrán fin al nuevo romance entre Lucas y Robin cuando él la lleve a París?

programme.title: Lizzie
programme.desc: Lizzy, una adolescente de carácter fuerte pero malhumorado, es enviada a vivir al rancho de su abuela después de que un incidente en la escuela la haga suspender. Aunque reticente al principio, Lizzy empieza a relajarse con la ayuda de un poni sin nombre al que llama Hope. Cuando Lizzy se entera de la desafortunada noticia de que el rancho está a punto de ser embargado, idea un plan que no sólo salvará la propiedad de su abuela, sino que también ayudará a Hope en el proceso.

programme.title: Proyecto Navidad
programme.desc: Cuatro hermanos unen sus fuerzas para vengarse de los Hagbarts, los matones más malos de su escuela.

programme.title: Austentatious
programme.desc: Las amadas obras de Jane Austen se unen cuando Elinor, Marianne, Emma y Lizzie unen fuerzas como las mejores amigas del mundo de hoy.

programme.title: Coronas y Cintas para Navidad
programme.desc: Cuando una fabricante de coronas se lesiona el brazo, un amable vecino interviene para ayudarla a mantener su negocio de coronas en funcionamiento durante la ajetreada temporada navideña. Mientras trabajan juntos, ambos forman un vínculo inesperado y una conexión navideña.

programme.title: Aprendiendo A Amar
programme.desc: Cuando su novio la deja, Steph se muda a Los Ángeles y acepta un trabajo como tutora de las hijas de un exitoso arquitecto en los Hamptons. Todo parece perfecto hasta que surgen sentimientos entre ellos, y las niñas deciden intervenir antes de que el romance se venga abajo.

programme.title: Corriendo a Casa para Navidad
programme.desc: Emily Nichols, una exitosa consultora de negocios que viaja mucho por trabajo, no ha visto a su familia en todo el año. Llegar a casa para Navidad es muy importante para ella, pero después de una serie de obstáculos, sus planes de vacaciones están en peligro. Sin embargo, Emily tropieza, literalmente, con un compañero "guerrero de la carretera", Simon Allein, quien amablemente ayuda a Emily incluso cuando los percances de viaje aumentan.

programme.title: Romance Navideño
programme.desc: Mandy, la dueña de una tienda de manualidades y pasatiempos, descubre una copia antigua de "A Christmas Carol" entre las donaciones para una campaña de donación de libros y juguetes. En el libro hay una carta a Papá Noel de hace 70 años y una moneda valiosa. Mandy se propone encontrar al dueño del libro, la carta y la moneda con la ayuda de Jonah, un contratista que lo encontró y donó el libro. En el camino, encuentran pistas que los acercan más al autor y el uno al otro, pero ¿puede Mandy devolverle todo al dueño del libro a tiempo para Navidad y hacer realidad su propio deseo navideño?

programme.title: Navidad en Escocia
programme.desc: En un viaje a Escocia, una diseñadora de instalaciones se encuentra ayudando a una pequeña comunidad a crear un despliegue festivo de luces, a pesar de las intervenciones de un rico heredero. Obligados a trabajar juntos, se unen para llevar la magia estacional a la luz.

programme.title: La Prueba de Atracción
programme.desc: Mientras una aclamada profesora universitaria se prepara para presentar su estudio más importante, uno que despierta el amor entre desconocidos, su lanzamiento se ve amenazado cuando recibe críticas por no poner a prueba ella misma la “Prueba de las Citas”. Aunque ha jurado no volver a enamorarse, acepta someterse al experimento junto a su crítico más severo.

programme.desc: Cuando una fabricante de coronas se lesiona el brazo, un amable vecino interviene para ayudarla a mantener su negocio de coronas en funcionamiento durante la ajetreada temporada navideña. Mientras trabajan juntos, ambos forman un vínculo inesperado y una conexión navideña.

programme.title: Aprendiendo A Amar
programme.desc: Cuando su novio la deja, Steph se muda a Los Ángeles y acepta un trabajo como tutora de las hijas de un exitoso arquitecto en los Hamptons. Todo parece perfecto hasta que surgen sentimientos entre ellos, y las niñas deciden intervenir antes de que el romance se venga abajo.

programme.title: Corriendo a Casa para Navidad
programme.desc: Emily Nichols, una exitosa consultora de negocios que viaja mucho por trabajo, no ha visto a su familia en todo el año. Llegar a casa para Navidad es muy importante para ella, pero después de una serie de obstáculos, sus planes de vacaciones están en peligro. Sin embargo, Emily tropieza, literalmente, con un compañero "guerrero de la carretera", Simon Allein, quien amablemente ayuda a Emily incluso cuando los percances de viaje aumentan.

programme.title: Romance Navideño
programme.desc: Mandy, la dueña de una tienda de manualidades y pasatiempos, descubre una copia antigua de "A Christmas Carol" entre las donaciones para una campaña de donación de libros y juguetes. En el libro hay una carta a Papá Noel de hace 70 años y una moneda valiosa. Mandy se propone encontrar al dueño del libro, la carta y la moneda con la ayuda de Jonah, un contratista que lo encontró y donó el libro. En el camino, encuentran pistas que los acercan más al autor y el uno al otro, pero ¿puede Mandy devolverle todo al dueño del libro a tiempo para Navidad y hacer realidad su propio deseo navideño?

programme.title: Navidad en Escocia
programme.desc: En un viaje a Escocia, una diseñadora de instalaciones se encuentra ayudando a una pequeña comunidad a crear un despliegue festivo de luces, a pesar de las intervenciones de un rico heredero. Obligados a trabajar juntos, se unen para llevar la magia estacional a la luz.

programme.title: La Prueba de Atracción
programme.desc: Mientras una aclamada profesora universitaria se prepara para presentar su estudio más importante, uno que despierta el amor entre desconocidos, su lanzamiento se ve amenazado cuando recibe críticas por no poner a prueba ella misma la “Prueba de las Citas”. Aunque ha jurado no volver a enamorarse, acepta someterse al experimento junto a su crítico más severo.

programme.title: Los rebeldes de Arizona
programme.desc: Una pareja de recién casados se interpone en el camino de los ladrones de tierras que esperan el nuevo ferrocarril. Un duro pistolero les ayuda mientras atraviesan una serie de encuentros con la compañía ferroviaria, apaches, ladrones y traficantes de armas.

programme.title: Persecución mortal
programme.desc: El pistolero Silver es contratado por un abogado para demostrar que su cliente, Chester Conway, es inocente del atraco a la taberna por el que ha sido condenado a la horca.

programme.title: Réquiem para el gringo
programme.desc: Un euro-western único con el héroe como astrólogo que lleva un traje de leopardo.

programme.title: El Puro se sienta, espera y dispara
programme.desc: Un grupo de asesinos busca al pistolero El Puro por la recompensa de 10.000 dólares.

programme.title: Uno después de otro
programme.desc: Uno después de otro - Stan Ross, un pistolero con gafas, llega a Canyon City y se involucra con dos facciones enfrentadas después de que un empleado fuera asesinado por el banquero Jefferson durante un asalto fallido mientras robaba su propio banco.

programme.title: Clint, el solitario
programme.desc: Clint Harrison es un pistolero que lleva años huyendo de enemigos vengativos. Regresa al pueblo que abandonó años antes para descubrir que su familia se ha mudado para huir de su mala reputación.

programme.title: Clayton Drumm
programme.desc: El ferrocarril contrata a un asesino condenado para asesinar a un ranchero que no coopera, pero el asesino no cumple, lo que hace que los hombres del ferrocarril vayan a por él.

programme.title: Un hombre vino a matar
programme.desc: Tony Garrett, condenado injustamente por el robo de un tesoro del ejército, escapa de prisión decidido a encontrar a los verdaderos responsables. En su camino hacia la venganza, enfrentará traiciones, trampas y viejos enemigos mientras intenta limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, juicio de fuego
programme.desc: Daniel Boone conduce a los colonos a Kentucky, pero debe luchar contra los indios Shawnee que han sido convencidos por un renegado francés de que Boone y los colonos están allí para matarlos y robarles sus tierras.

programme.title: Cabalgando hacia la muerte
programme.desc: Dos hermanos, Billy y Dan, se dirigen a California, decididos a cazar y matar al Zorro para vengar la muerte de su hermano.

programme.title: Yo los mato, tú cobras la recompensa
programme.desc: Un forajido y un cazarrecompensas buscan al bandido mexicano Corbancho, que dirige la zona de El Paso, y que además ha robado 400.000 dólares al Banco de Tuscon.

programme.title: La muerte no cuenta los dólares
programme.desc: Lawrence White vuelve a Owell Rock para vengar la muerte de su padre. Para proteger su identidad y asegurar su venganza, cambia su nombre y contrata a otro hombre para que se haga pasar por él, iniciando un juego peligroso de engaños y justicia.

programme.title: Los buitres cavarán tu fosa
programme.desc: Los buitres cavarán tu fosa - Como el bandidaje se vuelve incontrolable poco después de la Guerra Civil Americana, la compañía de transportes Wells Fargo contrata a unos Pistoleros, para protegerse de las incursiones cada vez más frecuentes.

programme.title: Frontera de tormentas
programme.desc: Tras escapar de la banda de los Silers, Winnetou y su hermana llegan a Miramonte junto a Old Firehand. Mientras la banda prepara un ataque para liberar a uno de los suyos, Old Firehand descubre un importante secreto familiar. Unidos, deberán organizar la defensa del pueblo frente a la inminente amenaza.

programme.title: 20.000 dólares por un cadáver
programme.desc: Una pareja de granjeros lucha por sus tierras frente a un desconocido decidido a sabotear la construcción de un ferrocarril. Su tranquila vida se ve amenazada por intrigas y peligros que podrían arruinar su futuro.

programme.title: El ángel y el pistolero
programme.desc: Quirt Evans, un malvado en toda regla, es atendido y buscado por Penelope Worth, una chica cuáquera. Al final se ve obligado a elegir entre su mundo y el de Penelope.

programme.title: La Muerte Busca un Hombre
programme.desc: Forsythe, que usa a su esposa como cebo, ha ganado una reputación como pistolero.

programme.title: El Coyote
programme.desc: En 1848 los EEUU se anexionan California, los hispanos son ahora discriminados por los yanquis. Para acabar con los abusos Don César ordena a su hijo estudiante que regrese de Europa. Los lugareños se ríen de este ridículo dandi. Pero no todo es lo que parece.

programme.title: Casta indomable
programme.desc: Un joven abogado muy brillante con un temperamento muy rápido viaja a Mission, una pequeña ciudad fronteriza de Texas para ajustar cuentas por el asesinato de su padre, un operador del servicio secreto a manos de traficantes de armas

programme.title: 500 $, vivo o muerto
programme.desc: Un pie tierno se convierte en cazarrecompensas con la esperanza de labrarse un futuro mejor para él y su nuevo amor.

programme.title: Scalps: Venganza India
programme.desc: El comandante de un fuerte tejano en la Guerra de Secesión se niega a rendirse a los norteños e intenta comprar a la hija del jefe de la tribu india local. El sabio jefe se niega y los sureños masacran a la tribu y secuestran a la joven india. La noble india consigue escapar y se esconde con un rudo ranchero, a quien no le gustan los indios, pero odia más a los sureños. La extraña pareja une fuerzas, y tácticas, para ejercer la venganza definitiva sobre los hombres del fuerte.

programme.title: El imperio del ganado
programme.desc: Liberado de la cárcel, un jefe de ganado es solicitado por los barones rivales para conducir sus respectivos rebaños de ganado a Fort Clemson.

programme.title: Fuerte solitario
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una repentina oleada de asesinatos en la región del Big Bend de Texas, las sospechas recaen inmediatamente sobre un joven vagabundo que acaba de mudarse a la zona.

programme.title: El sabor de la venganza
programme.desc: El sabor de la venganza - Tres hermanos desiguales buscan venganza por el asesinato de su padre. Cada uno de ellos toma un camino diferente.

programme.title: Killer calibre 32
programme.desc: El súper genial Silver elimina uno a uno a los siete miembros de una banda enmascarada. Entre chicas de taberna y partidas de póquer, la acción no para hasta el dramático desenmascaramiento del jefe de la banda malvada.

programme.title: Le llamaban Calamidad
programme.desc: Mientras un infame pistolero salva a unos granjeros de gente que intenta explotarlos, se enamora de una hermosa viuda.

programme.title: El blanco, el amarillo y el negro
programme.desc: En el siglo XIX, cuando el emperador japonés envía un poni de regalo al presidente de los EE.UU., éste es robado y rescatado por los indios, pero el sheriff Gideon, ayudado por un inepto sirviente japonés, se ofrece a entregar el rescate.

programme.title: La senda de la traición
programme.desc: Tras la Guerra Civil, el forajido Rollins y su banda provocan tensiones entre colonos e indígenas. Winnetou y Old Shatterhand intentan mantener la paz, pero Winnetou es acusado de asesinar al hijo del jefe Búfalo Blanco, con pruebas falsas. Old Shatterhand debe descubrir la verdad y salvar a su amigo.

programme.title: El pistolero más tembloroso del Oeste
programme.desc: Una ladrona de diligencias indultada, se convierte en agente del gobierno y se casa con un ingenuo y desprevenido dentista de la costa este para unirse a una caravana.

The show is known for its gentle humor, engaging storytelling, and colorful animation that appeal to preschool-aged children. With each episode, young viewers are invited into Kipper's world where everyday experiences turn into magical explorations, fostering a love for learning and imagination.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Esta es la historia de amor de una mujer fuerte; Serafima, quien está en un triángulo amoroso. Durante veinte años, su rival y ella han amado al mismo hombre. Además de melodrama, también muestra la vida cotidiana. Un relato sobre la historia de Rusia a través de los ojos de una persona. El destino de Serafima refleja la historia de todo el país: desde la época soviética, la perestroika, hasta la época actual.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima queda embarazada de Víctor. Tras una pelea, él es herido y ella lo cuida. Irina, la chica que Víctor ama, descubre la verdad y lo deja. Víctor y Sima se casan, pero él solo espera el nacimiento del bebé.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: El hijo de Sima nace con una grave enfermedad del corazón. Víctor la culpa. Sima busca ayuda médica en Moscú y conoce a una periodista que duda que un cirujano famoso la opere.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Irina y Víctor retoman su romance. Sima acude al cirujano Krasin por su hijo y termina salvándolo de un atentado. Agradecido, Krasin acepta operar al niño.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima pierde a su bebé y queda estéril. Irina queda embarazada de otro hombre pero miente diciendo que es de Víctor. Sima le propone divorcio a Víctor y cae en una profunda depresión.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima convence a Irina de darle el bebé a cambio de dinero. Irina se marcha, mientras Víctor planea estudiar veterinaria. Irina, en caída libre, recurre a la brujería para vengarse de Víctor, quien es diagnosticado con leucemia.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima vende sus caballos para pagar la cirugía de Víctor en Alemania. Un adicto roba el dinero y lo entrega a un traficante. Víctor huye del hospital en busca del ladrón.

programme.desc: Víctor muere e Irina culpa a Sima. Irina intenta llevarse a su hija, pero Sima sigue adelante con la ayuda de la niña y de su ahijada. Vania, el hijo de Sima, regresa del ejército y se enamora de una empleada de Irina.

programme.desc: Vania le propone matrimonio a Larisa, pero Sima no la aprueba. Irina manipula a Vania para que reclame su parte de la granja. Sima conoce a un editor llamado Andréi en un viaje.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, the rhythm of life is dictated by survival. It’s a rugged existence, but the DIRT crew discovered it breeds a wild, abundant kinship. Their guide, chef Jeremy Charles, turned Newfoundland’s raw ingredients into world-class cuisine. He took them out to stock up his way—with fishing poles, shotguns, and foraging baskets. That resourcefulness fueled a final feast of everything from moose tongue to fresh urchin, served at a classic Newfoundland “shed party.”

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: How important is the wild harvest to communities in North America? Dan Cabela travels from Kansas to Newfoundland in search of the answer, meeting rural communities that rely on the yearly cycle of wild game harvest.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: The Green Way team continue their African journey with hunts for both the majestic Kudu and elusive Golden Wildebeest. The experience comes full circle when the meat from these animals is donated to local schoolchildren, who receive not only fresh meals but also school supplies and sweets that light up the village.

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.desc: Danny meets up with a local rally cars fabricator who takes him fishing. Ryan and his kids show Danny a thing or two about trolling on the lake.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: From battling towering 12-foot waves in the Gulf of Alaska, to reeling in colossal 200 lb. halibut, they discover firsthand the rugged beauty of America's 49th state. This episode highlights Lindell Yachts as a top builder of rugged offshore sportfishing yachts, as well as Radon Boats as great pilothouse fishing and guide boats.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael continues the family tradition of fish stew and gathering, with hopes that Larkin will pass on the same traditions.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Capt. Josh heads offshore with Marcus Castro for a day of fishing, hoping to reel in the perfect catch for tonight’s family dinner.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Capt Josh and Johnny from Johnny Jigs head out with gorgeous weather on their side to hit some reefs and put the jigs to work!

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Captain Josh and the fam head out to do some surf fishing to see what’s biting. Then ended the day building professional sand castles and playing goofy golf.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: The bite’s dead during a neap tide, but Josh and Isaiah don’t back down. Watch them adapt, pivot, and turn a tough day into a hard-earned win. It’s not luck—it’s hustle.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Josh and Alex explore the SS United States; the world‘s largest artificial reef.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff venture deep into Maine’s backcountry with their buddy Chuck, ice fishing remote lakes only reachable by snowmobile. Their journey ends at the legendary “ghost trains,” a pair of abandoned locomotives that now rest as silent monuments to a forgotten logging era.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America’s most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff scour the rugged mountains of southern Arizona in search of the elusive Coues deer, known to hunters as the “Grey Ghost.” Through scorching sun and shifting winds, they test their skill and patience chasing one of North America’s most elusive big game animals.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: The Green Way team continue their African journey with hunts for both the majestic Kudu and elusive Golden Wildebeest. The experience comes full circle when the meat from these animals is donated to local schoolchildren, who receive not only fresh meals but also school supplies and sweets that light up the village.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson on an epic hunting adventure in the stunning landscapes of New Zealand as he goes after Whitetail deer. On this hunt, Mark was unable to get his firearms import permit in time to take his Gunwerks rifle, so he'd have to borrow a trusty rifle from his guide, Shawn. Get ready for heart-pounding action, breathtaking scenery, and valuable tips and tricks from a seasoned hunter.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: The hunt for FREAK SHOW became a thrilling adventure after I spotted him on Cabela’s trail cam. Having hunted Kentucky for over a decade and established my own properties—Bootleggers Ridge and Stonewall Plantation—I was eager for the chance at such a remarkable deer. Despite having drawn a coveted caribou tag through Worldwide Trophy Adventures’ TAGS Program, the allure of FREAK SHOW was too strong to resist. After careful planning and waiting for the right wind, I finally - set out on September 11. With my crossbow in hand, I waited anxiously in the stand, my heart racing as the shadows lengthened. Just when I thought the evening might end without a sighting, a movement caught my eye, sending my pulse soaring. With caution, FREAK SHOW appeared.

programme.title: The Journey Within

Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.desc: La vida de una bailarina exótica da un giro aterrador cuando una maldición comienza a consumir su mundo. Mientras el miedo, el deseo y lo sobrenatural chocan, debe enfrentarse a la oscuridad que la rodea antes de que destruya su vida por completo.

programme.title: Axe to Grind
programme.desc: La leyenda de las películas de bajo presupuesto, la actriz Debbie Wilkins, acaba de ser reemplazada por una tierna piel de 23 años en la cama de su amante. Peor aún, se ha quedado fuera del nuevo protagónico. Debbie no toma bien este rechazo y afrenta.

programme.title: Confinamiento
programme.desc: Los vecinos de un edificio despiertan encerrados por extraños con trajes protectores. Sin saber quién está infectado, el miedo y la desconfianza se apoderan de ellos, desatando una intensa lucha por la supervivencia dentro del encierro.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today’s brand new Come Dine With Me Professionals heads to Birmingham, where our first hosts are Seafood restaurant The Oyster Club’s head chef Rosie and front of house Jess.

programme.title: Wall of Chefs
programme.desc: One home cook tries to pull out crowd-pleasing wontons in 30 minutes, and it’s a sweet, sour, and spicy Chef’s Fridge round as the home cooks use Chef Nuit Regular’s Thai ingredients.

programme.title: Zumbo's Just Desserts
programme.desc: Welcome to the magical world of dessert making. In a homage to the art of conjuring and illusion, our competitors must create magical desserts that melt, crack and lift away, to reveal an inner delight.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Bun and Co are kicking off the competition in Birmingham this week, where Head Chef Ruman and front of house manager Syeem are hoping their brand of Indian style fusion fast food will wow their guests. The boys have a great deal of banter and fellow restaurateurs Jojo and Toni from The Lion Sports Bar certainly enjoy the atmosphere. Though when Toni reveals her hatred of melted cheese, Paul and Liz from the Rafters are concerned for their menu.

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: Italy’s vast coastline provides ample opportunity to enjoy fresh seafood across the country. Silvia cooks two dishes, Zupetta Di Pesce and Baked Snapper for a close friend’s 60th Birthday. These recipes are some of Italy’s most popular seafood dishes, but Silvia’s version features a slight twist to keep you on your toes!

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Prepare for pure decadence! Kirsten stuns with showstopping choux buns, nut-filled caramel wheels, and citrus-infused chocolate crackles. Along the way, she reveals her top tips and tricks for mastering chocolate like a pro.

programme.title: Wall of Bakers
programme.desc: One home baker tries to go with the flow with a lava cake in the first round, and Chef Lynn Crawford hits a sweet spot with the Meyer lemons and honey in her pantry.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Host Sarah Sharratt dives into the French love of oysters. She visits the windswept Atlanic coast, with its epic sand dunes, breathtaking views, and famous oyster farms. Sarah gets a hands-on lesson in oyster harvesting and places a bid at the famous fish auction in Arcachon. A stop in at St. Emilion to pick up some white wine is the last stop before Sarah heads home to prepare a sea-inspired meal.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
programme.desc: Jamie kicks things off by cooking up his Crazy Good Pork Burger—a naughty little treat that takes fast food to the next level. Then it’s sticky mango prawns, a speedy sharing platter with a shortcut to phenomenal flavor.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Great pork starts with how the animal is raised. Jenn learns about pork production and enjoys a true farm to table dinner.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
